name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B SaaS Implementation & Customer Onboarding Specialist

Post-sale delivery is the through-line: ~94% retention across a 15–20 partner portfolio at Birdeye, team lead for onboarding and launch operations at Wix, and concurrent end-to-end implementations today through Solenzo. I run kickoff, technical configuration, data migration and hygiene, training, and adoption for SaaS customers, and I build the CRM architecture and automated workflows underneath. Fifteen years of client-facing account work before that means I read stakeholder risk early and escalate it before it becomes a delay.
